issues.detail: The instructions focus on happy path scenarios and do not cover error handling or edge cases.
The documentation contains verbose explanatory sections that could be trimmed for brevity.
The skill is tightly coupled to GCP services and does not support other cloud providers or generic AI agents.
Auth Proxy binary is downloaded without a checksum, increasing risk of tampering.

scenarios.name: setup-production-cluster-with-read-pool
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but misses the cluster availability flag, while Response B omits several key commands and flags.

scenarios.name: enable-vector-search-on-existing-database
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response A omits the required extensions, uses the wrong vector dimension, lacks an SQL UPDATE, and does not use the specified similarity operator or filter.

scenarios.name: terraform-provision-alloydb-cluster
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B omits key elements such as cluster_id, initial_user, correct backup policy, and instance configuration.
